method.phaseBreakdown: init wall + input tokens/native prefill rate + output tokens/native decode rate + provider residual + SDK outside provider
method.preview: SDK callback publication; not screen paint
method.warmup: one startup request per reuse arm, reported separately and excluded from measured-request medians and pairs; no case cooldown is required before warmup
method.mtpAcceptance: engine-close session measurement; one warm arm value or separate cold sessions
method.pairing: same device, case occurrence, reuse, other control, model path/size, corpus, prompt, profile settings, source text and rendered prompt; strict interpretation also requires equal raw/final output and native output token count
method.renderTiming: saved A2UI compiler and Activity handoff measured separately; UiAutomator status-label observation is an accessibility polling upper bound, not pixel paint
